accepted_claims: For all integers k>=2 the explicitly defined graph is finite, simple, directed, and unit-edge-cost with k distinct ordered terminals.
Its exact integral optimum is C_k-k^2, where C_k=sum_{l=1}^k (k-l+1)floor(k/l).
A feasible vector for the original edge path-distance LP has objective C_k/3.
Its actual gaps have liminf at least 3.
not_accepted_as_proved: Solution of the original constant-versus-unbounded question
